summary: Targeted re-review recovered the missing Table 2 and results-text activity matrix, reconciled linked DBAASP rows against primary XML/table evidence, preserved source-limited hemolysis and modified-construct cautions, and closed rwk-complete-test-0001 without fabricating figure-only values.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2 activity extraction and worker-4 database reconciliation are now source-reviewed from local XML/PDF/package/database surfaces; worker-6 accepts with explicit cautions and no blocking rework targets.

materials_exhausted.note: Local OA supplementary ZIP was opened; its PDF contains Figure S1/Table S1 but no additional exact activity matrix beyond primary text/table. Figure-only exact curve values were not fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP linked IC50 rows now match primary section 2.3/Table 2 values and citation metadata. Hemolysis rows whose exact database values are only plot/qualitative locally are retained as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 26 source-backed records were recovered from Table 2, section 2.3 results text, hemolysis/LDH text, and methods locators; database-only exact plot values were not promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism is bounded to membrane-disruption-associated cytotoxicity supported by SEM, LDH, trypan blue, and hemolysis assays, without overclaiming unavailable plotted curve points.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP exact hemolysis entries are not all tabulated in local primary text; unsupported exact value(s) remain source_conflict instead of being promoted as source_verified.
LVTX-9/LVTX-9-C18 database sequence keys store the core peptide sequence while primary Table 1 reports terminal amide and C18 modification context.
Full plot-derived dose-response values from Figure 3D/F and Supplementary Figure S1 were not digitized; table/text-supported values were extracted and curve-only exact values were not fabricated.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local XML/text states LVTX-9-C18 causes about 10% hemolysis at 25 μM and stronger hemolysis above 25 μM, but does not tabulate the exact 50% at 50 μM value carried by DBAASP; Figure 3F is available only as a plotted image/caption in the local packet.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: DBAASP hemolysis row 22186 is preserved as source_conflict and is not promoted as a primary-source activity row; supported IC50 and approximate hemolysis/LDH values remain recorded.
